faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Addressing Common Questions About the LIMS Pro System
faq.question1: Is LIMS Pro suitable for small laboratories?
faq.answer1: Yes, LIMS Pro is designed specifically for small laboratories with a size from small to medium. The system can be scaled to meet the needs of development.
faq.question2: Do we need to train employees to use the system?
faq.answer2: LIMS Pro has an intuitive and easy-to-use interface. We provide basic training and 24/7 support during the implementation process.
faq.answer3: Absolutely! We use end-to-end encryption, automatic backups, and compliance with international healthcare security standards.
faq.question4: How much does the system deployment cost?
faq.answer4: We have flexible service packages suitable for any size. Contact us for detailed consultation and specific pricing.
